svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Event-driven document processing on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Event-driven document processing on Google Cloud. 10 components in 2 groups. Connections: Customers to Cloud Run (HTTPS); Cloud Run to Cloud Storage (write object); Cloud Storage to Eventarc; Eventarc to Cloud Run; Cloud Run to Document AI (process document); Cloud Run to Firestore (save fields); Cloud Run to Pub/Sub (publish); Cloud Run functions to Eventarc; Eventarc to Pub/Sub.

text.tspan: EVENT-DRIVEN DOCUMENT PROCESSING ON GOOGLE CLOUD
Eventarc routes an upload to Cloud Run for Document AI and Firestore, then a Pub/Sub event to the notifier
